# Huiseok Moon

<div class="hero-tagline">Assistive Robotics · Physical Human–Robot Interaction · Wearable Robotics</div>

<div class="hero-location">📍 Bourg-la-Reine, France &nbsp;·&nbsp; Postdoctoral Researcher, Université Paris-Est Créteil (LISSI)</div>

I design clinically validated real-time intent detection frameworks and assistive
robotic control systems built on multimodal sensing (EMG, IMU) — with the aim of
building exoskeletons and orthoses that understand what a person is trying to do,
before they finish doing it.

## Research Interests {.section-title}

My research combines **Assistive Robotics** and **Physical Human-Robot Interaction**,
building on my experience designing clinically validated real-time intent detection
frameworks and assistive robotic control based on sensor systems (EMG, IMU, etc.). I
am interested in physics-based modeling and simulation, model-based control, and
multimodal AI for understanding and predicting human motion — with a focus on
mobility assistance for wearable robotics.

::: {.interest-grid}
::: {.interest-card}
#### Wearable Robotics
Actuated ankle-foot orthoses and lower-limb exoskeletons for gait and mobility assistance.
:::

::: {.interest-card}
#### Assistive & Adaptive Control
Impedance control, funnel-based and fuzzy-adaptive control for human-exoskeleton interaction.
:::

::: {.interest-card}
#### Multimodal Learning
LSTM / GRU / attention-based models fusing EMG, IMU, and FSR signals for intent and gait recognition.
:::

::: {.interest-card}
#### Nonlinear & Model-Based Control
Physics-based modeling and model predictive / reference-tracking control for rehabilitation robots.
:::
:::
